reviews.reason: s0052 has the Longyou governors (竇沖、王統、毛興、王廣、楊璧、楊定) send envoys to 丕 asking to punish 姚萇; s0058 brands 羌賊姚萇 a former herdsman turned rebel, and s0084 has 匹蘭 deliver the captured 王廣 to 姚萇. This is consistently the Later Qin founder, the enemy of Fu Pi's court. Other locals in this chapter (for example p118) are separate and not merged here. zh:姚苌 overflow (32 dossiers, 8 visited) keeps identity unresolved.

s0305 徐嵩，字元高，盛之子也: the bare 盛 is Xu Song's father, so the surname 徐 is inherited from the son. He is not the Three Kingdoms Wu general 徐盛 that several of the seven bounded headers appear to index. Because this is a single kinship attestation, the 徐盛 headers cannot prove or rule out identity.

s0259 與萇將姚崇爭麥于清水，累為崇所敗: 萇將 marks 姚崇 as Yao Chang's general, and short 崇 repeats him in the same sentence. He is not the Tang chancellor 姚崇/姚元崇 (courtesy 元之) among the headers. zh:姚崇 overflow (47 dossiers, 8 visited) leaves cross-record identity unresolved.

s0159 urges the prince not to imitate 曹臧、吳劄一介微節: 吳劄 is Ji Zha of Wu, the classic example of a royal heir who renounced the throne, paired with Zizang of Cao. He is invoked as an exemplar, not a contemporary actor. The name claim cites s0159, although no Chinese mention span is recorded. Two 吳劄 headers do not prove equivalence.

s0121 斬丕首，執其太子甯、長樂王壽: 甯 is Fu Pi's crown prince, captured by the Jin general 馮該 and handed to 苻宏. He is distinct from 長樂王壽 in the same clause. With no candidate dossiers and no overflow, the accepted single-local record is retained.

s0056 永與司空蠔等 places 蠔, as Minister of Works, beside 王永 in raising Fu Pi's successor, and s0062 司空張蠔為中軍都督 confirms him by the full name. This is the same Former Qin 張蠔 as p011 (canonical per_THCY7R2MP3YW4EVN7R8W, which is in this bounded list), whose s0013 appointment is 司空. The two are separate locals, and this report cannot merge them. Overflow keeps identity unresolved.

s0101 has 沒奕於 and his allies defeat 萇左將軍姚方成、鎮遠強京 at 孫丘谷. Here 鎮遠 is 強京's office under Yao Chang, paired with 姚方成, and 強京 is a personal name, not a place or title. With no candidates and no overflow, the accepted singleton is retained.

s0319 長生慘虐 and s0338 長生昏虐 are summation verdicts using 長生, the courtesy name of the tyrant Former Qin emperor 苻生. Fu Pi and Fu Deng are named separately in those comments. zh:苻生 overflow (11 dossiers, 8 visited) leaves cross-chapter identity unresolved.

s0043 以子胤為鷹揚將軍，率眾五萬距光於酒泉, and s0045 胤及光戰于安彌，為光所敗. 胤 is the son of 梁熙 (p020), sent against 呂光 and routed at Anmi, so the surname 梁 comes from the father. Five 梁胤 headers are bounded index entries, not proof of identity.

s0018 楊輔為尚書右僕射、濟陽公 is one entry in Fu Pi's Jinyang appointment roster. His office and ducal title match the record's claims, and he is distinct from 張蠔 and 王騰 in neighbouring entries. Five 楊輔 headers cannot certify identity.

s0272 興將尹緯據橋以待之 makes 尹緯 Yao Xing's general at the abandoned bridge, and s0274 與緯大戰，為緯所敗 repeats him as short 緯 when Fu Deng is routed. Six 尹緯 headers, one with three members, remain unresolved Later Qin matches.

s0124 苻纂及弟師奴率丕余眾數萬，奔據杏城: 師奴 is Fu Zuan's younger brother leading Fu Pi's remnant to Xingcheng, and the sibling relation to p072 is explicit. Later locals for the same pair (such as the s0190 fratricide) are separate and not merged here. Three 師奴/苻師奴 headers leave identity unresolved.

s0002 苻丕，字永叔，堅之長庶子也 is the biographical opening for Fu Pi, Fu Jian's eldest son by a secondary consort. s0006 and s0007 track him leaving and re-entering 鄴, and s0011 records his accession at Jinyang. Other 苻丕 locals in this chapter, including the s0334 summation p232 (per_HAH9P29SFAJRJJ6X0054 in the bounded list), are not merged here. zh:苻丕 overflow (14 dossiers, 8 visited) keeps identity unresolved.

s0184 苻纂敗姚碩德于涇陽，姚萇自陰密距纂 is Fu Zuan fighting Yao Chang's forces, s0189 places 苻纂 with 蘭犢 in the move toward Chang'an, and s0190 師奴勸其兄纂稱尊號…乃殺纂 records his murder, which the death claim reflects. The earlier s0124 苻纂 local (p072) is separate and not merged here. Four headers remain bounded uncertainty.

s0196 立其子崇為皇太子，弁為南安王，尚為北海王: 崇 is Fu Deng's son named crown prince, distinct from his brothers 弁 and 尚 in the same appointment. The single header per_H5SQHN9C6X4S9R61QRZ9 (the s0275 太子崇 local p202) is the same crown prince in a separate local, which this report cannot merge. Identity stays unresolved.

s0084 廣亡奔秦州，為隴西鮮卑匹蘭所執，送詣姚萇: 匹蘭 is the Longxi Xianbei chief who captures the fleeing 王廣 and delivers him to Yao Chang. This is the only attestation; with no candidates and no overflow, the accepted singleton is retained.

s0010 驃騎張蠔、并州刺史王騰迎之 has 張蠔 receive Fu Pi at Jinyang, and s0013 以張蠔為侍中、司空，封上黨郡公 appoints him. He is the same Former Qin general and minister as the s0056 司空蠔 local p055 (per_ST3ZA4P89E14K616ZHK4), which is a separate local not merged here. The 張鎬/張皓 headers are different names. Overflow keeps identity unresolved.

s0044 敦煌太守姚靜、晉昌太守李純以郡降光: 姚靜 is the Administrator of Dunhuang who surrenders to 呂光 and is paired with 李純 of Jinchang. He is not a member of the Qiang Yao clan of Later Qin in this context. One 姚靜 header leaves cross-record identity unresolved.

s0237 馮翊郭質起兵廣鄉以應登 introduces the Fengyi loyalist and his manifesto. s0246 to s0249 follow short 質: Fu Deng appoints him 平東將軍、馮翊太守, he is beaten by 苟曜, and he goes over to 萇. The headers are 郭芝 and one English-only 'Guo Zhi', which do not establish equivalence.

s0061 少康、光武之功可旬朔而成 is rhetoric in the Fu Pi-era proclamation comparing a dynastic restoration to Shaokang and 光武. 光武 is Emperor Guangwu of the Eastern Han, an exemplar rather than an actor. The zh:光武 (49) and English (59) overflow keeps identity unresolved, and no merge with the 43-member header is made.

s0121 執其太子甯、長樂王壽: 壽 is the Prince of Changle captured with Fu Pi's heir by 馮該 and later returned to 苻宏. The surname 苻 is inferred from that royal context. The single header 伏壽 is a different name and is not evidence of identity.

s0179 原大王遠蹤光武推聖公之義: 聖公 is the courtesy name of the Gengshi Emperor 劉玄, whom Guangwu initially deferred to. The counsel urges Fu Deng's camp toward clan unity. It is a historical exemplar, not a contemporary actor. No candidates were retrieved, and the missing blocking name keeps identity unresolved, as proposed.
s0087 刁雲殺慕容忠，乃推慕容永為…河東王: 刁雲 is the Western Yan officer who kills 慕容忠 and elevates 慕容永, and he acts on his own in that sentence. One 刁雲 header remains bounded uncertainty.

s0215 以尚書苻碩原為前禁將軍、滅羌校尉，戍平涼 records Fu Deng's Director being appointed to garrison Pingliang after the capture of 吳忠 and 唐匡. This is the only attestation. With no candidates and no overflow, the accepted singleton is retained.

s0108 狄道長苻登雖王室疏屬，而志略雄明 is 啖青's nomination of Fu Deng, and s0111 推登為帥 and s0112 丕以登為征西大將軍…南安王 follow with short 登. s0125 苻登稱尊號 records his claim to the throne. Other Fu Deng locals in this chapter are separate and not merged here. zh:苻登 overflow (17 dossiers, 8 visited) keeps identity unresolved.
s0004 堅與言將略，嘉之，命鄧羌教以兵法: Fu Jian assigns the Former Qin general 鄧羌 to teach Fu Pi military methods. He is the instructor, not Fu Pi. zh:邓羌 overflow (10 dossiers, 8 visited) keeps identity unresolved.

s0010 并州刺史王騰 receives Fu Pi at Jinyang with 張蠔, and s0015 王騰為散騎常侍、中軍大將軍、司隸校尉、陽平郡公 appoints him in Fu Pi's roster. Both sentences describe one Bingzhou official. Four 王騰 headers do not prove corpus identity.

s0096 姚萇殘虐，慕容垂凶暴 is a loyalist manifesto naming Murong Chui, the Later Yan founder, beside Yao Chang. He is distinct from 姚萇 in the same parallel phrase. zh:慕容垂 overflow (47 dossiers, 8 visited) and English overflow keep identity unresolved.
s0227 雷惡地馳謂登曰 warns Fu Deng about 姚萇's stratagems, and s0229 萇聞惡地之詣登也…此羌多奸智 repeats him as 惡地, a Qiang chief. Three headers (two 雷惡地 and one 雷惡) remain bounded uncertainty.
